syllabus_topics: Course introduction, fundamentals of cartesian tensor calculus
Fundamental balance equations. General transport equation, material derivative. Equation of continuity. Momentum balance - Cauchy´s equation of dynamical equilibrium in continua
Angular momentum balance. Kinematics of fluid flow. Rheological constitutive equations
Navier-Stokes equation
Inspection analysis of the Navier-Stokes equation. Drag coefficient with flow around objects
Solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations in limiting cases. Engineering Bernoulli equation. Darcy-Weissbach equation. Frictional loss coefficient. Boundary layer
Turbulent flow. Friction factor and frictional losses and drag coefficient with turbulent flow. Mechanical energy balance
Residence time distribution. Internal energy balance and heat transfer. Fourier´s law of heat conduction
Fourier-Kirchhoff ´s equation. Fourier´s equation. Steady-state heat conduction. Thermal resistance. Overall heat tranfer coefficient
Multidimensional heat conduction problems. Heat conduction with internal sources or sinks. Unsteady heat conduction in solids
Forced convection. Momentum and heat transfer analogy
Natural convection. Mixed convection. Heat transfer with boiling and condensation
Radiation heat transfer. Fundamental concepts and equations of mass transfer
Fick´s law. Molecular mass transfer. Mass transfer with chemical reactions. Unsteady mass transfer. Convective mass transfer. Interphase mass transfer
Course introduction. Practical examples of momentum and heat transfer
Basis of tensor calculus - examples. Application of angular momentum balance
Solutions of momentum balance - Cauchy´s equation in one-dimensional cases
Approximation solution of momentum balance
Solution of steady-state heat conduction without and with internal sources
Solution of unsteady heat conduction in solids
Forced and natural convection. Calculation of heat exchanger
